speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS).

The clinical picture of a 32-week preterm infant with maternal diabetes, presenting with tachypnea, grunting, flaring, and cyanosis, is classic for RDS. The presence of maternal diabetes increases the risk of neonatal hypoglycemia and further respiratory compromise. I am confident in this diagnosis based on the gestational age, maternal history, and specific physical exam findings.
